name: Fraser Coast
aboutDesc: Brought to you by the Fraser Coast Regional Council and operated by shop local experts Why Leave Town, the Fraser Coast Gift Card is aimed at encouraging people to shop local. Each card that is purchased can only be spent in local participating businesses...meaning all the money stays local!
